interventions.speaker: CHAIR
interventions.who: the senior urologist who signs the decision
interventions.body: The prognosis is influenced by several factors, including a preoperative PSA of 9.3 and positive surgical margins. The pathological findings show an ISUP grade group 2 (Gleason 3+4) with no extraprostatic extension, seminal vesicle invasion, or lymph node metastasis documented from the prostatectomy specimen. A notable discrepancy exists between the biopsy finding of Gleason 4+3 (ISUP group 3) and the lower grade found post-surgery. The absence of nodal status information is not applicable as nodes were sampled. Prognostic revision would be significantly aided by postoperative PSA levels and their subsequent trajectory, which are currently unknown. The fixed estimated horizon is 62.79 months. This represents expected follow-up without an event, not a known recurrence date. The sensitivity range is 50.23–75.35 months; its coverage has not been validated.
